title: Universally that person’s acumen
html_source:
Beginning with this very difficult portion (“Universally that person’s acumen” through “ever irrevocably enjoined?”), Joyce is imitating literally translated (as in word-for-word) dense classical Latin prose such as that written by Sallust and Tacitus.

Have fun trying to parse this one.
